# leakshield > 🌐 English | [繁體中文](./README.zh-TW.md) **A gatekeeper that scans for sensitive content before you feed code, documents, or data to AI services.** Three supported modes: - **OpenCode Plugin**: The enforced ingress gate for OpenCode. Use this when OpenCode sends content to a model. - **CLI**: Manual or CI scanning of text, files, and directories; supports redaction. - **Web UI**: Local browser interface and REST endpoint for manual scanning. MCP server mode has been removed. It depended on the model voluntarily calling a scan tool after it had already received the relevant context, so it cannot provide the plugin's security boundary. | Mode | Start it with | Use it for | |------|---------------|------------| | OpenCode Plugin | Add the `leakshield` package or the `dist` directory to `opencode.json` (OpenCode v2) | Automatic, fail-closed protection for OpenCode model inputs and tool outputs | | CLI | `npm run scan -- --file ./path` (or `leakshield --file ./path` after a global install / `npm link`) | Explicit local or CI scans; it never sends content to a model | | Web UI | `npm run web` | Manual browser scans at `http://localhost:3000` | ## Project status **Experimental, `0.x`.** Published to npm as `leakshield`: run `npx leakshield --help` to see the commands, or build locally (`npm ci && npm run build`) and point OpenCode at the `dist` directory. Without arguments or input, the CLI waits on stdin. - Transparent mode has been verified on OpenCode v2.0.28 with local loopback providers, and once against a real OpenAI model. It is **not** a guarantee that nothing sensitive reaches a model: the recommended hook-first setup is reported as `PARTIAL` by `--doctor`, and content added after the plugin's hooks or sent by permitted tools (curl, remote MCP) is outside its coverage. - Not yet verified: OS-keychain custody on Windows and Linux (macOS verified 2026-10-20), a real Anthropic provider, long histories on other providers, long-running use ([#26](https://github.com/jwcrystal/leakshield/issues/26)). - Defaults may still change during `0.x`; see the [changelog](CHANGELOG.md). - Verification records: [docs/evidence](docs/evidence/README.md). Report vulnerabilities privately: [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). License: [MIT](LICENSE). --- ## Quickstart Needs OpenCode v2 and Node.js 20 or later. 1. Install: ```bash npm install -g leakshield ``` 2. Register the plugin in your project's `opencode.json`. With no options, `mode` defaults to `transparent`: ```jsonc { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugins": [{ "package": "leakshield" }] } ``` 3. Check the install. Exit code 0 means `PROTECTED` or `PARTIAL`; see [what `PARTIAL` means](#what-partial-means). This check cannot see inside a live session, so run step 4 as well. ```bash leakshield --doctor ``` 4. Run the smoke test. It uses a temporary directory and a synthetic value, not a real credential: ```bash SMOKE_DIR="$(mktemp -d)" cat > "$SMOKE_DIR/opencode.json" <<'EOF' { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugins": [{ "package": "leakshield", "options": { "mode": "block" } }] } EOF (cd "$SMOKE_DIR" && opencode run --standalone \ "Smoke test only. Do not reveal or use this token: sk-AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA") rm -rf "$SMOKE_DIR" ``` The model-facing message must contain the LeakShield block notice and must not contain the synthetic token. Do not use a real credential for this test. Before relying on it, read [what this protects — and what it does not](#what-this-protects--and-what-it-does-not). For source builds and other options, see [Installation](#installation) and [OpenCode Plugin](#opencode-plugin-recommended). New contributors: [3-minute onboarding](docs/ONBOARDING.zh-TW.md) (Traditional Chinese only). --- ## Detection Coverage | Type | Description | Severity | |------|-------------|----------| | API Key | OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, AWS, Stripe (live keys) | 🔴 HIGH | | Secret / Password | Generic password assignments, AWS Secret | 🔴 HIGH | | Token | GitHub, Slack, Hugging Face, JWT, Bearer Token | 🔴 HIGH | | Private Key | PEM private key blocks | 🔴 HIGH | | DB Connection String | MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL, Redis, ADO format, etc. | 🔴 HIGH | | Taiwan National ID | Format validation | 🔴 HIGH | | Credit Card Number | 13–19 digits, Luhn checksum required | 🔴 HIGH | | IBAN | Compact or 4-char groups, mod-97 checksum required | 🔴 HIGH | | Public IPv4 Address | Private/loopback/CGNAT/reserved ranges excluded; runs longer than four groups are reported whole | 🟡 MEDIUM | | Private IPv4 / VPN CIDR | **Opt-in** — disabled by default (`rule_overrides["private-ipv4"]: true`); networks from `settings.private_cidrs`, default RFC 1918 + CGNAT + link-local | 🟡 MEDIUM | | Email Address | All email formats | 🟡 MEDIUM | | URL Embedded Credential | `scheme://user:password@host` — only the userinfo span is masked | 🔴 HIGH | | Taiwan Mobile Number | **Opt-in** — disabled by default (`rule_overrides["phone-tw"]: true`); digit runs are a measured false-positive source | 🟡 MEDIUM | | International Phone | **Opt-in** — disabled by default (`rule_overrides["phone-intl"]: true`); same trade-off as above | 🟢 LOW | | HTTP(S) URL | **Opt-in** — disabled by default (`rule_overrides.url: true`) | 🟢 LOW | | NDA Keywords | Custom (see `config/guard.config.yaml`) | 🔴 HIGH | | Private Domains | Custom (see `config/guard.config.yaml`) | 🟡 MEDIUM | > **Detection boundaries** (per `src/rules/builtin.ts`): the generic secret rule matches only the keywords `password`, `passwd`, `secret`, `private_key`, `client_secret` with a value of **8+ characters** — generic `api_key=`/`token=` assignments are not matched unless the value itself matches a vendor pattern. It also skips an unquoted value that is a code expression, such as `process.env.DB_PASSWORD` or `z.string().min(6)`; a call whose arguments hold another string literal is still reported. Credit card and IBAN matches require a valid checksum, and the credit card rule skips a run of one repeated digit and digits inside a UUID. The URL credential and DB connection rules skip a password that is a `${…}`, `{{…}}` or `<…>` placeholder. IP matches cover only public/routable IPv4, and a dotted run longer than four groups is reported whole so an address embedded in it is masked instead of left behind (dotted dates such as `2026.10.21.14.32.59` therefore report as an IP run too). Not covered by any rule: street/postal addresses, dates, IPv6, and values below the 8-character minimum for generic secret assignments. SSH remote authorities (`user@host:path`, `ssh://user@host/…`) are not reported as email; private domains and path keywords still apply inside them, and the password half of `scheme://user:password@host` is reported as a URL credential instead. Private IPv4 is opt-in because the literal also matches version numbers and timestamps; `settings.private_cidrs` narrows it to the organisation's own ranges, and an entry that does not parse fails the config load. Every built-in rule has a stable id and can be toggled via `settings.rule_overrides` in `config/guard.config.yaml` (unknown ids fail config load); the URL rule ships disabled because always-on URL masking would flag provider endpoints. The same rule set (built-in + `config/guard.config.yaml`) applies to every mode — `block`, `redact`, and `transparent`. --- ## Decision Model Every scan produces a **decision** that tells the caller how to handle the content: | Decision | When | Risk Level | Meaning | |----------|------|-----------|---------| | `ALLOW` | No findings | LOW | Content is clean — safe to send | | `WARN` | LOW-severity findings only | MEDIUM | Minor items detected — reminder shown, content can be sent | | `CONFIRM` | MEDIUM or HIGH findings | HIGH / CRITICAL | Sensitive content detected — user must explicitly confirm | ### CONFIRM Handling When the decision is `CONFIRM`, the CLI is non-interactive: it prints a warning card and a next-step hint, and does not prompt you to choose. The hint points to `--format json` (read `redactedContent`) or `--redact` (sanitized output). Exit code `1` means the content was blocked. The `CONFIRM` decision includes: - `recommendedAction`: `REVIEW` (MEDIUM findings) or `BLOCK` (HIGH findings) - `safePreview`: a masked excerpt around the first finding - `redactedContent`: the full content with all sensitive spans replaced `safePreview` and `redactedContent` are left out when a sensitive span cannot be located exactly, such as an encoded run split by a zero-width character. A missing field means no safe version is available. ### JSON Output Fields When using `--format json`, the output includes these decision-oriented fields: | Field | Description | |-------|-------------| | `decision` | `ALLOW`, `WARN`, or `CONFIRM` | | `riskLevel` | `LOW`, `MEDIUM`, `HIGH`, or `CRITICAL` | | `recommendedAction` | `REVIEW` or `BLOCK` (CONFIRM only) | | `findings` | Array of sanitized findings (no internal metadata) | | `safePreview` | Masked excerpt (CONFIRM only; can be absent) | | `redactedContent` | Full redacted text (CONFIRM only; can be absent) | --- ## Installation Requires Node.js 20 or later. Mapping persistence needs 22.13 or later. ```bash npm install -g leakshield leakshield --help ``` `npx leakshield …` runs the published package without installing it. The npm package ships only the compiled code, so it has no `config/` directory; see [Configuration](#configuration) to add one. To build from source: ```bash git clone https://github.com/jwcrystal/leakshield.git cd leakshield npm install npm run build ``` For local development, install the build globally or `npm link` it, then use `leakshield` directly. `npm run scan -- ...` works from this repository without installing. ### npm Scripts | Command | Description | |---------|-------------| | `npm run build` | Clean, then compile TypeScript → `dist/` | | `npm run clean` | Remove `dist/` | | `npm start` | Run the built CLI (`node dist/cli.js --cli`) | | `npm run dev` | CLI mode (no build needed) | | `npm run scan` | CLI scan (no build needed) | | `npm run web` | Start the local Web UI (no build needed) | | `npm test` | Run unit tests | | `npm run test:watch` | Run tests in watch mode | | `npm run binary` | Build standalone binary for current platform (macOS ARM) | | `npm run binary:win` | Cross-compile for Windows x64 | | `npm run binary:linux` | Cross-compile for Linux x64 | | `npm run binary:mac-intel` | Cross-compile for macOS Intel | | `npm run binary:win-icon` | Build the Windows binary with the app icon (`scripts/build-win.js`) | | `npm run binary:all` | Build all platforms at once | | `npm run bundle:mac` | Build the binary and package a macOS bundle (`scripts/bundle-mac.sh`) | --- ## Standalone Binary Can't use Node.js or npm? Build a standalone binary with [Bun](https://bun.sh) — no runtime needed on the target machine. ```bash # One-command build for current platform npm run binary # Cross-compile for other platforms npm run binary:win # Windows x64 → leakshield.exe npm run binary:linux # Linux x64 → leakshield-linux npm run binary:all # All platforms ``` Or directly with Bun: ```bash bun build --compile --target=bun-windows-x64 ./src/cli.ts --outfile=leakshield.exe ``` The output is a single executable — hand it to anyone, no dependencies required. ### Configuration for binary and npm users The binary and the npm package work out of the box with built-in defaults. To customize rules (NDA keywords, private domains, custom regex patterns), place a config file in one of these locations: | Location | Scope | |----------|-------| | `./config/guard.config.yaml` | Current working directory | | `~/.leakshield/guard.config.yaml` | All sessions (user home) | ```bash # Quick start: copy config/guard.config.example.yaml from this repository, # then replace its sample keywords and domains mkdir -p ~/.leakshield cp config/guard.config.example.yaml ~/.leakshield/guard.config.yaml # Or per-project mkdir -p ./config # Create/edit ./config/guard.config.yaml as needed ``` See [Configuration](#configuration) section for available options. --- ## Usage ### OpenCode Plugin (recommended) When loaded successfully, the OpenCode plugin is the enforced integration. It scans and blocks user text before OpenCode persists or sends it to a model, sanitizes system prompts and tool definitions, protects tool output before the next model turn, and re-scans history before replay. It always enables encoded-content detection. Invalid plugin options or scanner configuration make every protected hook fail closed and abort the model request. A bounded SHA-256 decision cache avoids repeatedly scanning unchanged history without retaining original or redacted content. Transparent mode details: [Encoded content and tool schemas](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.md#encoded-content-and-tool-schemas). LeakShield supports OpenCode v2 only. v2 hosts load the package `id` + `setup(ctx)` definition. OpenCode v1 is no longer supported: a v1 host that loads the package gets hooks that fail closed and abort every model request, and `leakshield --doctor` reports `BROKEN`. Upgrade to OpenCode v2. **OpenCode v2** — point `plugins` at the published package, or at the `dist` directory of a local build: ```jsonc { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugins": [ { "package": "leakshield" // or "/absolute/path/to/leakshield/dist" // No options: mode defaults to "transparent" on v2. // Add "options": { "mode": "block" } to refuse instead of pseudonymize. } ] } ``` Note that v2 only accepts plugin *directories* (it resolves `dist/index.js`) or package names; a `file://` URL to a single `.js` file is rejected with `configured plugin path must be a directory`. The default `mode` is **`transparent`** (see [Transparent mode](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.md)). `block` replaces unsafe content with a disclosure-free notice; set `"mode": "block"` to use it. Set `mode` to `redact` only when you explicitly want recognized direct matches replaced with `[REDACTED_TYPE]` placeholders. `--doctor` shows the mode in effect and marks it `(default)` when the options omit it. #### What `PARTIAL` means `leakshield --doctor` exits 0 for two statuses. They are install-level results, not a guarantee that nothing sensitive reaches a model. | Status | Setup | Meaning | |--------|-------|---------| | `PROTECTED` | `block` or `redact`, or transparent with `wireProtection` omitted or `true` (the v2 default) | Install-level checks pass. In transparent mode, the final HTTP body or supported WS frame is validated too | | `PARTIAL` | Transparent with `wireProtection: false` ([hook-first example](config/opencode.hook-first.example.json)) | Final outbound HTTP bodies are not inspected | With `PARTIAL`: - Later-added content or attachments may leave unmasked, even with `attachments: "block"`. - **Content-hook masking failures still refuse the affected call**; hook-only does not silently forward unprotectable raw content. See [Wire protection](docs/plugin/wire-protection.md) for both levels. #### Detailed guides - [Transparent mode](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.md): placeholders, supported protocols, shell argument restoration, restart limitation - [Wire protection](docs/plugin/wire-protection.md): hook-only and final wire levels, AI SDK providers, refusals, reply-side recovery - [Native WebSocket](docs/plugin/websocket.md): experimental Responses-family support and its limits - [Mapping persistence](docs/plugin/persistence.md): opt-in encrypted storage, key custody, erasure - [Capacity and lifecycle](docs/plugin/capacity.md): budgets, session limits, retention - [Readonly env queries](docs/plugin/env-queries.md): opt-in tools that answer configuration questions without returning values #### Persistence risk notes (read before enabling) Mapping persistence is opt-in; see [Mapping persistence](docs/plugin/persistence.md). - The design is dual-secret — the DB file alone or the ke …[文件过长——仅保留首 16KB 与末 8KB]… string }`, returns JSON | --- ## Configuration LeakShield loads the first config file it finds: `./config/guard.config.yaml`, then `config/guard.config.yaml` in the LeakShield directory (source builds only), then `~/.leakshield/guard.config.yaml`. With no file, the built-in defaults apply. The OpenCode plugin also accepts a `configPath` option. To start a new file, copy [`config/guard.config.example.yaml`](config/guard.config.example.yaml) and replace its sample keywords and domains. ```yaml # NDA keywords (case-insensitive) nda_keywords: - "CONFIDENTIAL" - "INTERNAL ONLY" - "DO NOT SHARE" - "NDA" - "PROPRIETARY" # Add your own internal keywords: # - "Project Phoenix" # - "MyCompany Internal" # Private domains private_domains: - "internal.mycompany.com" # - "dev.yourcompany.io" settings: max_chars: 200000 # scan bound; transparent mode refuses past it instead of truncating show_line_numbers: true preview_length: 60 encoding_detection: false # Base64/URL/Hex decoding; off by default ``` After editing: - **CLI**: Reloaded automatically on next run - **OpenCode Plugin**: Restart OpenCode to reload the plugin configuration - **Web UI**: Restart the local server ### Exact `.env` Value Detection Enable this only for files whose values should never enter an LLM context: ```yaml settings: env_files: - .env - .env.local ``` Paths are relative to the workspace root and must remain inside it. LeakShield reads non-empty values of at least eight characters, then detects exact occurrences in text sent to the model. It does not automatically read `.env`, process environment variables, or send, log, or serialize the loaded values. Restart OpenCode after changing an enabled env file. The opt-in `envQueries` plugin tools (see [Readonly env queries](docs/plugin/env-queries.md)) query these same files and never return their values. ### Custom Rules ```yaml custom_rules: - description: "Company token" pattern: "MYCO_[A-Z0-9]{32}" severity: HIGH flags: "i" # subset of gimsuy; g is always implied word_boundary: true # \b only at literal ASCII word edges allow: # exact strings this rule never reports - "MYCO_EXAMPLE0000000000000000000000000" # path: ["src/**"] # accepted, but NOT implemented (see below) settings: allowlist: # exact strings no rule reports (see the bypass warning) - "qa@example.com" ``` - **`flags`** — any subset of `gimsuy`; `g` is always added. The default is `i`, so existing rules keep matching case-insensitively. An unknown flag (such as `x`) fails the config load, and the pattern is compiled with the final flags, so a pattern that is only invalid under `u` also fails the load. Zero-length matches are skipped (they contain no value to report or redact); scanning continues to later nonempty matches, including under Unicode flags. - **`word_boundary`** — adds `\b` where the pattern's edge is a literal ASCII word character. A CJK edge (「機密」) is left alone: `\b` never holds between two non-word characters, and wrapping it would stop the rule matching. An edge that is a group, character class, quantifier or escape cannot take a boundary safely, so none is added and `--doctor` warns that the rule is looser than it looks — write `\b` in the pattern yourself, e.g. `\bEMP-\d{6}\b`. A top-level alternation (`a|b`) is a config error; group it as `(?:a|b)`. - **`allow` / `settings.allowlist`** — exact matches against the matched text, not substrings and not regexes. `allow` applies to that rule; `settings.allowlist` applies to every rule, including the built-in ones and exact `.env` values. Caps: 32 entries per rule, 64 globally, 200 characters each. **Allowlisting a live secret is a real bypass**: the value still leaves the machine unmasked, and LeakShield will not report that value as a rule or `.env` finding. Use it only for values you have decided are not sensitive. Unicode evasion diagnostics are separate: a zero-width or look-alike-letter warning means removing those characters exposes a finding the raw text hides, and an allowlist on the raw text does not silence it. Cyrillic or Greek text on its own is not flagged. `--doctor` reports how many entries exist, exercises up to eight of them, and reports how many it could not exercise (a context-dependent pattern can only be judged in place). Suppressions are counted rather than silent. - **`path`** — accepted and validated, but path scoping is **not implemented**: the scanner has no source path for prompts or tool output. These rules currently apply to every scanned text, and `--doctor` warns when `path` is set. Allowlist entries are part of the config file, so they change its fingerprint (sha256 of the file), which is what authorizations compare against. --- ## Practical Examples ### Scenario 1: Asking OpenCode to review a config file With `mode: "block"`, shown below. In the v2 default, transparent mode, the model sees a placeholder instead and the task continues. ``` You (to OpenCode): Please review this config.ts for issues OpenCode: [reads config.ts] → Tool output contains an API_KEY → Plugin replaces it before the next model turn → OpenCode receives a block notice instead of the secret You: Replace line 12 with a dummy key, then continue ``` ### Scenario 2: CLI scan before submitting a project ```bash npm run scan -- --dir ./my-project # If exit code = 1, there are findings — fix them before sharing with AI ``` ### Scenario 3: CI/CD integration (block sensitive prompts from the pipeline) ```bash # Add to your CI script node dist/cli.js --cli --dir ./prompts if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "❌ Sensitive content detected — stopping pipeline" exit 1 fi ``` --- ## Configuration Validation Input lengths for dynamic rules are validated when the config is loaded: | Field | Max length | |-------|-----------| | `nda_keywords` entries | 200 characters | | `private_domains` entries | 255 characters | | `custom_rules` `description` / `pattern` | 200 characters | Values exceeding these limits will cause `loadConfig()` to throw a Zod validation error, preventing oversized patterns from entering the scanner. List sizes are capped too, and a config over a cap fails the load: | Field | Max entries | |-------|-------------| | `nda_keywords` | 4096 | | `private_domains` | 4096 | | `custom_rules` | 1024 | A `custom_rules` pattern that does not compile as a regular expression also makes `loadConfig()` throw, naming the rule's index and `description` (not the pattern): a rule that cannot be enforced must not load. A pattern that compiles but runs slowly on a fixed probe input is skipped as a ReDoS suspect, with a warning on stderr and a `custom-rules` warning in `leakshield --doctor`. That check is a timing heuristic, not a guarantee: it runs the pattern once and cannot interrupt it, so it cannot prove a pattern safe. ## Secret Preview Behavior All secret previews in scan results are **fully masked** as `****`, regardless of the secret's length. No prefix or suffix characters from the original value are preserved. This eliminates partial secret exposure in logs, CI output, and Web UI responses. ## Internationalization (i18n) CLI output language is controlled by the `LEAKSHIELD_LANG` environment variable. | Value | Language | |-------|----------| | `en` (default) | English | | `zh-TW` or `zh` | Traditional Chinese | ```bash # English output (default) npm run scan -- --text "your content" # Traditional Chinese output LEAKSHIELD_LANG=zh-TW npm run scan -- --text "你的內容" ``` You can also set it persistently in your shell profile: ```bash export LEAKSHIELD_LANG=zh-TW ``` ## Notes - This tool performs **static pattern matching** and cannot guarantee 100% coverage - **Common false positives**: literal test values long enough to match (e.g. `password: "aaaaaaaa"`), placeholder values in example code - The tool is meant to **warn**, not guarantee — final judgment is always yours - Keep NDA keywords focused on truly confidential terms to avoid excessive false positives

Transparent 模式已在 OpenCode v2.0.28 搭配本機替身 provider 驗證，並用真實 OpenAI 模型驗證過一次。它**不保證**敏感內容絕不會送到模型：建議的 hook-first 設定在 `--doctor` 顯示為 `PARTIAL`，hook 之後才加入的內容，以及被允許的工具外送（curl、遠端 MCP），都不在保護範圍內。 - 尚未驗證：Windows 與 Linux 的 OS keychain 持久化（macOS 已於 2026-10-20 驗證）、真實 Anthropic provider、其他 provider 的長對話、長時間使用（[#26](https://github.com/jwcrystal/leakshield/issues/26)）。 - 每次掃描都會產生一個**決策**，告訴呼叫端該如何處理內容： | 決策 | 時機 | 風險等級 | 意義 | |------|------|----------|------| | `ALLOW` | 沒有發現 | LOW | 內容乾淨，可安全送出 | | `WARN` | 只有 LOW 嚴重度的發現 | MEDIUM | 偵測到次要項目，顯示提醒，內容仍可送出 | | `CONFIRM` | 有 MEDIUM 或 HIGH 的發現 | HIGH / CRITICAL | 偵測到敏感內容，使用者必須明確確認 | ### CONFIRM 的處理方式 決策為 `CONFIRM` 時，CLI 是非互動式的：會印出警告卡片與下一步提示，不會請你選擇。提示會建議使用 `--format json`（讀取 `redactedContent`）或 `--redact`（輸出脫敏版本）。Exit code `1` 表示內容已被攔截。 `CONFIRM` 決策包含： - `recommendedAction`：`REVIEW`（MEDIUM 發現）或 `BLOCK`（HIGH 發現） - `safePreview`：圍繞第一個發現的遮罩摘錄 - `redactedContent`：所有敏感片段都已取代的完整內容 無法精確定位敏感片段時（例如編碼片段中夾了零寬字元），不會有 `safePreview` 和 `redactedContent`。欄位不存在代表沒有可用的安全版本。 ### JSON 輸出欄位 使用 `--format json` 時，輸出包含以下與決策相關的欄位： | 欄位 | 說明 | |------|------| | `decision` | `ALLOW`、`WARN` 或 `CONFIRM` | | `riskLevel` | `LOW`、`MEDIUM`、`HIGH` 或 `CRITICAL` | | `recommendedAction` | `REVIEW` 或 `BLOCK`（僅 CONFIRM） | | `findings` | 已清理的發現陣列（不含內部中繼資料） | | `safePreview` | 遮罩摘錄（僅 CONFIRM；可能不存在） | | `redactedContent` | 完整的脫敏文字（僅 CONFIRM；可能不存在） | --- definition，並在下一輪模型讀取前清理工具輸出及歷史訊息。它會固定啟用編碼內容偵測。plugin 選項或掃描設定無效時，所有受保護 hook 都會 fail closed 並中止模型請求。受限的 SHA-256 決策快取會避免重複掃描未變動歷史，同時不保留原文或脫敏後內容。 Transparent 模式細節見[編碼內容與 tool schema](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.zh-TW.md#編碼內容與-tool-schema)。 LeakShield 只支援 OpenCode v2：v2 載入套件的 `id` + `setup(ctx)` 定義。OpenCode v1 已不再支援：v1 host 載入此套件時會得到 fail-closed 的 hooks，中止每一個模型請求，`leakshield --doctor` 也會回報 `BROKEN`。請升級到 OpenCode v2。 **OpenCode v2** — 將 `plugins` 指向已發佈的套件，或本機 build 的 `dist` 目錄： ```jsonc { "$schema": "https://opencode.ai/config.json", "plugins": [ { "package": "leakshield" // 或 "/絕對路徑/leakshield/dist" // 不設定 options 時，v2 的 mode 預設為 "transparent"。 // 想改成直接攔截，加上 "options": { "mode": "block" }。 } ] } ``` 注意 v2 只接受 plugin「目錄」（會解析 `dist/index.js`）或套件名稱；指向單一 `.js` 檔的 `file://` URL 會被拒絕，並出現 `configured plugin path must be a directory`。 `mode` 的預設值是 **`transparent`**（見 [Transparent 模式](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.zh-TW.md)）。`block` 會用不含機敏值的攔截訊息替換危險內容；想使用這個行為，請設定 `"mode": "block"`。只有在你明確希望已辨識的直接命中改為 `[REDACTED_TYPE]` 佔位符時，才設定 `mode: "redact"`。`--doctor` 會顯示實際生效的 mode，沒有設定時會標示 `(default)`。 #### `PARTIAL` 的意思 `leakshield --doctor` 在兩種狀態下 exit 0。它們是安裝層的結果，不保證敏感內容絕不會送到模型。 | 狀態 | 設定 | 意思 | |------|------|------| | `PROTECTED` | `block` 或 `redact`，或 transparent 且 `wireProtection` 省略或為 `true`（v2 預設） | 安裝層檢查通過。transparent 模式下也會驗證最終的 HTTP body 或支援的 WS frame | | `PARTIAL` | Transparent 且 `wireProtection: false`（[hook-first 範本](config/opencode.hook-first.example.json)） | 不檢查最終出站 HTTP body | `PARTIAL` 時： - 後續新增內容／附件可能未遮罩，即使設定 `attachments: "block"`。 - **Hook 內無法遮罩的輸入仍拒絕該次請求**；不是靜默放行原文。 兩種層級的說明見 [Wire 保護](docs/plugin/wire-protection.zh-TW.md)。 #### 詳細說明 - [Transparent 模式](docs/plugin/transparent-mode.zh-TW.md): 佔位符、支援的協定、Shell 參數還原、重啟限制 - [Wire 保護](docs/plugin/wire-protection.zh-TW.md): hook-only 與 final wire 兩種層級、AI SDK provider、拒絕、回覆端復原 - [Native WebSocket](docs/plugin/websocket.zh-TW.md): 實驗性的 Responses-family 支援與限制 - [映射持久化](docs/plugin/persistence.zh-TW.md): 選擇性開啟的加密儲存、金鑰保管、清除 - [容量與生命週期](docs/plugin/capacity.zh-TW.md): 預算、session 上限、保留 - [唯讀 env 查詢](docs/plugin/env-queries.zh-TW.md): 選擇性開啟、不回傳 value 的設定查詢工具 #### 持久化風險須知（開啟前必讀） 映射持久化需選擇性開啟，見[映射持久化](docs/plugin/persistence.zh-TW.md)。 - 設計為雙秘密——單獨拿到 DB 檔或金鑰都解不開，兩者同時才行。 - 備份（Time Machine、雲端同步）會複製 `SGP.db`：`forget` 無法回收備份已抄走的內容，還原備份＋尚存的金鑰可再識別舊 session——備份保留政策請一併考量。 - keychain "internal.mycompany.com" # - "dev.yourcompany.io" settings: max_chars: 200000 # 掃描上限；透明模式超過即拒絕，不會截斷後送出 show_line_numbers: true preview_length: 60 encoding_detection: false # 編碼檢測（Base64/URL/Hex），預設關閉 ``` 修改後： - **CLI**：下次執行自動載入 - **OpenCode Plugin**：重啟 OpenCode 以重新載入 plugin 設定 - **Web UI**：重啟本機 server ### `.env` 精確值偵測 只有當檔案內的值絕不該進入 LLM context 時才啟用： ```yaml settings: env_files: - .env - .env.local ``` `env_files` 路徑相對專案根目錄，且不能離開 workspace。Guard 只讀取非空且至少 8 字元的 value，掃描準備送往模型的內容是否出現完全相同的值。載入的 value 不會傳給模型、寫入 log 或序列化；也不會自動讀取所有 process environment variables。修改已啟用的 `.env` 後，請重啟 OpenCode。選擇性開啟的 `envQueries` plugin 工具（見[唯讀 env 查詢](docs/plugin/env-queries.zh-TW.md)）查詢的是同樣這些檔案，且永不回傳其 value。 ### 自訂規則 ```yaml custom_rules: - description: "Company token" pattern: "MYCO_[A-Z0-9]{32}" severity: HIGH flags: "i" # gimsuy 的子集；一律隱含 g word_boundary: true # 只在字面 ASCII 單字字元的邊緣加 \b allow: # 這條規則永不回報的完整字串 - "MYCO_EXAMPLE0000000000000000000000000" # path: ["src/**"] # 可設定，但尚未實作（見下方） settings: allowlist: # 任何規則都不回報的完整字串（見繞過警告） - "qa@example.com" ``` - **`flags`** — `gimsuy` 的任意子集；一律加上 `g`。預設為 `i`，既有規則仍維持不分大小寫。未知旗標（例如 `x`）會讓設定載入失敗；pattern 以最終旗標編譯，所以只在 `u` 下才無效的 pattern 也會載入失敗。零長度比對會被略過（沒有可回報或脫敏的值），掃描會繼續找後面的非空比對，Unicode 旗標下也一樣。 - **`word_boundary`** — 只在 pattern 邊緣是字面 ASCII 單字字元時加上 `\b`。CJK 邊緣（「機密」）不處理：兩個非單字字元之間不會成立 `\b`，加上去反而比對不到。邊緣是群組、字元類別、量詞或跳脫序列時無法安全加上，所以不會加，`--doctor` 會警告這條規則比看起來寬鬆——請自己在 pattern 寫 `\b`，例如 `\bEMP-\d{6}\b`。最外層的 alternation（`a|b`）是設定錯誤，請寫成 `(?:a|b)`。 - **`allow`／`settings.allowlist`** — 與命中文字完全相同才算，不是子字串也不是 regex。`allow` 只作用於該規則；`settings.allowlist` 作用於所有規則，包括內建規則與 `.env` exact value。上限：每條規則 32 筆、全域 64 筆、每筆 200 字元。 **把真實密鑰加入 allowlist 是真正的繞過**：該值仍會不經遮罩離開本機，LeakShield 也不會把它回報為規則或 `.env` 命中。只用於你已判定不敏感的值。 Unicode 規避診斷是另一回事：零寬字元或形似字母的警告，代表移除這些字元後會露出原文隱藏的命中，對原文設 allowlist 不會消除警告。單純的西里爾或希臘文字不會被標記。`--doctor` 會回報 allowlist 筆數、實測最多八筆，並回報無法實測的筆數（依賴上下文的 pattern 只能在實際位置判斷）。被抑制的次數會計數，不是靜默略過。 - **`path`** — 可設定也會驗證，但路徑範圍**尚未實作**：掃描器拿不到 prompt 或工具輸出的來源路徑。這些規則目前套用於所有掃描文字，設定 `path` 時 `--doctor` 會警告。 Allowlist 項目屬於設定檔的一部分，所以會改變設定檔指紋（檔案的 sha256），而授權比對的正是這個指紋。 --- ## 實務使用建議 ### 場景一：你要把一個設定檔交給 OpenCode 分析 下面是 `mode: "block"` 的情況。在 v2 預設的 transparent 模式下，模型看到的是佔位符，工作會繼續進行。 ``` 你（對 OpenCode）：請幫我看看這個 config.ts 有沒有問題 OpenCode：[讀取 config.ts] → 工具輸出含有 API_KEY → plugin 在下一輪模型讀取前將其替換 → OpenCode 收到攔截通知，而非 secret 你：把第 12 行換成假 key 後再繼續 ``` ### 場景二：你在 CLI 掃描整個專案再送出 ```bash npm run scan -- --dir ./my-project # 如果 exit code = 1，表示有問題，先處理再貼給 AI ``` ### 場景三：CI/CD 整合（防止含敏感資訊的 prompt 進入 pipeline） ```bash # 在 CI script 加入 node dist/cli.js --cli --dir ./prompts if [ $? -ne 0 ]; then echo "❌ 偵測到敏感內容，停止 pipeline" exit 1 fi ``` --- ## 設定檔驗證 動態規則的輸入長度在載入時會透過 Zod 驗證： | 欄位 | 最大長度 | |------|---------| | `nda_keywords` 每個項目 | 200 字元 | | `private_domains` 每個項目 | 255 字元 | | `custom_rules` 的 `description` / `pattern` | 200 字元 | 超過長度限制的值會導致 `loadConfig()` 拋出 Zod 驗證錯誤，避免過長的 pattern 進入掃描器。 清單項目數也有上限，超過上限的設定檔會載入失敗： | 欄位 | 最多項目數 | |------|-----------| | `nda_keywords` | 4096 | | `private_domains` | 4096 | | `custom_rules` | 1024 | `custom_rules` 的 pattern 若無法編譯成正規表示式，`loadConfig()` 也會拋錯，並指出規則的索引和 `description`（不會印出 pattern）：無法執行的規則不能載入。可以編譯、但在固定測試輸入上跑得太慢的 pattern 會被當成疑似 ReDoS 而略過，stderr 會印警告，`leakshield --doctor` 也會出現 `custom-rules` 警告。這個檢查只是計時啟發式，不是保證：它只執行 pattern 一次，而且無法中斷執行，所以不能證明 pattern 安全。 ## 敏感資訊預覽行為 掃描結果中所有敏感資訊的預覽一律顯示為 `****`，不論原始值長度為何，不保留任何前後綴字元。這樣可避免在日誌、CI 輸出或 Web UI 回應中洩漏部分機密內容。 ## 多語系（i18n） CLI 輸出語言由 `LEAKSHIELD_LANG` 環境變數控制。 | 值 | 語言 | |----|------| | `en`（預設） | 英文 | | `zh-TW` 或 `zh` | 繁體中文 | ```bash # 英文輸出（預設） npm run scan -- --text "your content" # 繁體中文輸出 LEAKSHIELD_LANG=zh-TW npm run scan -- --text "你的內容" ``` 也可以寫進 shell profile 長期生效： ```bash export LEAKSHIELD_LANG=zh-TW ``` ## 注意事項 - 這個工具是**靜態 pattern 掃描**，無法保證 100% 覆蓋所有情況 - **高誤報情境**：長度足以命中的測試字面值（如 `password: "aaaaaaaa"`）、範例程式碼中的佔位符 - 最終判斷仍需你自己確認，工具的作用是「提醒」而非「保證」 - NDA 關鍵字請只填真正機密的詞，避免太多誤報影響使用體驗
